operation_id AS operationId, ordinal, chunk_id AS chunkId, document_id AS documentId, expected_content_hash AS expectedContentHash, state, lease_owner AS leaseOwner, lease_expires_at AS leaseExpiresAt, before_index_revision AS beforeIndexRevision, after_index_revision AS afterIndexRevision, detail, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO law_missing_embedding_repair_items ( operation_id, ordinal, chunk_id, document_id, expected_content_hash, state, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, before_index_revision, after_index_revision, detail, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
(#{operationId}, #{item.ordinal}, #{item.chunkId}, #{item.documentId}, #{item.expectedContentHash}, #{item.state}, #{item.leaseOwner}, #{item.leaseExpiresAt}, #{item.beforeIndexRevision}, #{item.afterIndexRevision}, #{item.detail}, #{item.createdAt}, #{item.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM law_missing_embedding_repair_operations WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM law_missing_embedding_repair_items WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} ORDER BY ordinal ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE law_missing_embedding_repair_items i JOIN law_missing_embedding_repair_operations o ON o.operation_id = i.operation_id SET i.state = 'NOT_ATTEMPTED', i.lease_owner = NULL, i.lease_expires_at = NULL, i.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE i.operation_id = #{operationId} AND i.state = 'READY' AND o.status = 'FAILED'

UPDATE law_missing_embedding_repair_operations o SET status = 'INDEXING_COMPLETE', lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE o.operation_id = #{operationId} AND o.status = 'RUNNING' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM law_missing_embedding_repair_items i WHERE i.operation_id = o.operation_id AND i.state <> 'INDEXED' )
